title: NNTP reader: STARTTLS accepted on already-TLS connection
description: reader/session/lifecycle.rs:64: after STARTTLS upgrade, run_session_io() is called with starttls_available=false, but this flag is not checked before dispatch_starttls(). A client sending STARTTLS on an already-TLS connection reaches 382 (proceed) instead of 580 (cannot initiate TLS). Rustls would likely reject the double-upgrade at the protocol level, but the NNTP state machine should reject it first with 580 per RFC 4642.
